title: Naturality of the base-change map
statement:
For a base-change square the
derived base-change maps $\operatorname{BC}_{f,g}(K)$ of
[sbc-def-base-change-map] are natural in $K$: for every morphism
$u:K\to K'$ in $D(T_{\Et},\Lambda)$ the square

$$
\begin{array}{ccc}
Lf^*Rg_*K & \xrightarrow{\ \operatorname{BC}_{f,g}(K)\ } & Rh_*Le^*K\\
\big\downarrow{\scriptstyle Lf^*Rg_*u} & & \big\downarrow{\scriptstyle Rh_*Le^*u}\\
Lf^*Rg_*K' & \xrightarrow{\ \operatorname{BC}_{f,g}(K')\ } & Rh_*Le^*K'
\end{array}
$$

is commutative.

proof.text: Apply the naturality equation of the module-coefficient natural transformation `derivedBaseChangeMap` recorded in [sbc-def-base-change-map], using its original declaration in `WeilConjectures.SixFunctors.BaseChange.DerivedUnbounded`, to `v` for the commutative square `sq.toCommSq.flip`. The two displayed composites are the maps of the composed functors; simplifying `Functor.comp_map` gives exactly the stated equality.

source.place: Proof, direct naturality of the recorded derived base-change natural transformation

proof_origin.place: The definition derivedBaseChangeMap is a natural transformation; its naturality field proves the statement directly.
